1) Redwood Inference is a US corporation (EIN: 83-219XXXX). We normally provide a W-9 for US-payee flows.
2) For your records: we do not have a VAT registration in the UK; we invoice net of VAT and do not expect VAT on this particular contract.
3) If your AP requires additional certification that Redwood is a US person for 1099 purposes, we can complete whatever your vendor portal needs or send a signed W-9.
4) Preferred payment method: ACH (USD) into our US bank. Wire is acceptable for EUR payouts but incurs wire fees.

I'm looping in Lauren (Finance lead) and Marissa (Sales ops) to confirm our standard attachments and to route a DocuSign W-9 to you.

Best,

Thanks for the ping, Karthik. Guidance below (copied from Finance playbook):

- Provide a completed W-9 (signed PDF). DocuSign is fine if AP prefers it — it adds an audit trail. Use the template in /Finance/Templates/W9 and include our EIN (83-219XXXX).
- 1099/Withholding: Novaresearch is an EU/UK payer — 1099 reporting is only for US payers, so they should not be expecting a 1099 from us. They should be classifying Redwood as a US payee. No backup withholding unless they notify us.
- VAT: confirm in the email that Redwood does not have a UK VAT registration and that VAT was not charged. If they push VAT treatment, have them provide their VAT registration for cross-check.
- Bank remit: attach our remit_instructions_ACH_wire.pdf (last updated 2027-06). For EUR wires we use the USD-equivalent billing unless they have a local FX arrangement; note wire fees.
- Required vendor onboarding docs (if requested): signed W-9, banking remittance stub, and a PO or contract reference (DL-9271). If they ask for beneficial owner attestation for a US corp, have them use the standard form in Templates/Ownership.

Once you send the W-9, ask AP to confirm the expected payment date and whether they need vendor portal access to attach docs. I'll log the docs in our secure drive link (send me the final PDF and I'll upload to /Finance/VendorDocs/Novaresearch_DL-9271).

Lauren Bishop
Head of Finance, Redwood Inference
